gitflow.delete_base.development.title: Delete development branch
gitflow.delete_base.development.warn: {branch} is the Git Flow development branch: features and releases start from it and every Finish merges into it. Until it exists again or Preferences > Git Flow names another branch, those steps can't run.
gitflow.delete_base.production.title: Delete production branch
gitflow.delete_base.production.warn: {branch} is the Git Flow production branch: releases and hotfixes are merged and tagged there, and hotfixes start from it. Until it exists again or Preferences > Git Flow names another branch, those steps can't run.
gitflow.delete_base.remote.warn: {remote} holds the copy everyone else uses.
gitflow.finish.stash_failed: {label} didn't start: your changes couldn't be stashed: {why}
gitflow.finish.stash_note.one: Your {count} changed file is stashed first and put back on {branch} once Finish is done.
gitflow.finish.stash_note.other: Your {count} changed files are stashed first and put back on {branch} once Finish is done.
gitflow.finish.steps.label: Steps:
gitflow.resume.dropped: Finishing {branch} can't continue: {why}. Its remaining steps were dropped.
gitflow.resume.forget.tip: Drop the remaining steps. Run them yourself or finish the branch again.
gitflow.resume.not_committed: Commit the merge into {into} first, then Continue finish.
gitflow.resume.nothing: There is no stopped finish to continue.
gitflow.resume.ready: The merge into {into} is committed, so finishing {branch} can go on. Still to do: {steps}.
gitflow.resume.waiting: This merge is part of finishing {branch}. Once it is committed, Continue finish does the rest: {steps}.
gitflow.resume.why.branch_moved: {branch} has new commits since the finish stopped
gitflow.resume.why.not_set_up: Git Flow is no longer set up
